name: browser
description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
one_liner: A super lightweight headless browser built from scratch, specifically so AI agents and automation scripts can browse the web faster and cheaper than with a full Chrome instance.
buyer: A company running thousands of AI web-browsing agents (scraping, testing, or research) who wants to cut hosting costs since this uses far less memory and CPU than headless Chrome.
business_use_cases: A web-scraping SaaS swaps its headless Chrome fleet for this to cut server costs while scraping the same volume of pages.
A QA automation company runs browser-based tests at much higher parallel density on the same hardware, lowering their CI infrastructure bill.
An AI agent platform uses it as the default browsing backend to make agent-driven web research cheaper to run at scale.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted 'browser farm' API billed per page-load, undercutting competitors that run costlier Chrome-based infrastructure.

steal_this: Build a simple benchmarking dashboard comparing cost-per-million-page-loads across this vs. headless Chrome vs. Playwright, and use it as lead-gen content for a hosted browsing API business.
